before_record.title: Jesus Christ & Scripture Art
before_record.text: Pause and remember Him Inspirational Art Reflect on Jesus Christ through art, scripture, faith, and hope. Open an artwork to view it full-size, study its gospel theme on the official Church website, or ask follow-up questions without losing your place in the gallery. Book of Mormon Evidences Faith in Liberty Jail Joseph and Porter Rockwell FEATURED ART & STUDY Spend a little more time with one picture. Read the scripture beside it, learn about the Savior, and consider what His words mean in your life. The Living Christ: Study The Good Shepherd: Study Suffer the Little Children: Study Be Still: Study Watch, read, and reflect Let the image lead you to scripture Compare a visual portrayal of the risen Savior with John 20, then continue into the linked scripture study. Church video Lively Hope of Resurrection Listen to a message about the hope we have because Jesus Christ lives. The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints Study the risen Christ in John 20 Let the image open a fuller study What catches your attention in the picture? Open a study below and read the scripture beside it. Return to both as you explore your questions. The Living Christ: witnesses and resurrection Follow John 20 from the empty tomb to the chapter’s stated purpose. Continue into the study of Jesus Christ or life after death. The Good Shepherd: care in the valley Compare John 10 with Psalm 23. Explore Christ’s self-giving care without reading the image as a promise of a trouble-free life. Suffer the Little Children: room to belong Read Mark 10 and 3 Nephi 17 in their separate settings, then consider specific ways to welcome and protect children. Be Still: attention, trust, and action Read Psalm 46 in a setting of upheaval, then explore Christ’s peace and responsible action while questions remain open. Take your time with a picture or a verse that speaks to you. You might pause to pray, write down a question, or simply look a little longer. There is no need to hurry to a conclusion. ❮ ❯
